items.title: Iran targets military bases as US launches wave of strikes
items.description: Explosions were heard across Iran overnight, shortly after neighbouring Gulf states began to report attacks.

items.title: Argentina face action over Falklands banner
items.description: Argentina face the prospect of disciplinary action from Fifa after their players celebrate the World Cup semi-final win against England with a banner in support of their country's claims to the Falkland Islands.

items.title: Families of 43 victims await verdict in Genoa bridge disaster
items.description: A large section of the giant Morandi motorway bridge crumbled and collapsed on to the railway tracks below.

items.title: US military to start screening for testosterone deficiency, Hegseth says
items.description: Hegseth says he is authorising hormone screening to ensure US troops "operate at your absolute best".

items.title: Actor Sam Neill died from pneumonia, agent confirms
items.description: Neill died in Sydney on Monday, with his family saying his death was 'sudden and unexpected'.

items.title: Eleven people die in fire at Algerian foster care home
items.description: Along with the fatalities, 19 people suffered injuries, the authorities say.

items.title: New monkey species with orange lips found 'hiding' in DR Congo forest
items.description: Scientists describe "amazing feeling" to look into the face of an animal that so few people knew existed.

items.title: More people around the world now favour China over the US, Pew study suggests
items.description: There is more confidence in Xi Jinping than Donald Trump, the US think tank's survey indicates.

items.title: French MPs approve assisted dying law with strict rules after years of argument
items.description: The bill would allow assisted dying for terminally ill adults who meet strict criteria.

items.title: Russian attacks kill 14 as Ukraine hits Black Sea oil tankers
items.description: Civilian casualties are reported in a number of Ukrainian regions, while Kyiv hits 20 Russian vessels in the Black Sea.

items.title: Special police team to investigate killing of an anti-migrant leader in South Africa
items.description: The March and March provincial leader died of his injuries in hospital several days after being shot.

items.title: Five arrested after Hong Kong police raid independent bookshops
items.description: Officials say they are suspected of selling "seditious" books which incited "hatred" against authorities.
